_why: studio's LOCAL direction catalog for design-pass variants (DEC-studio-0005): replaces impeccable's hosted roll as the default source of 'visual worlds'. Authored by the station from the impeccable command references (repertoire/pbakaus~impeccable/plugin/skills/impeccable/reference/*.md, read as data), Emil Kowalski's skills (repertoire/emilkowalski~skills/skills/*) and general design practice. Each direction is a complete starting point: palette roles, type pairing (system/local fonts only), spacing rhythm, radius, motion, composition, and which held methods shape it. Contrast of every ink/ground pair is checked by design_catalog.py --selftest with tools/design/contrast.py arithmetic.

directions.name: Ledger paper
directions.idea: A well-kept accounts book: warm off-white ground, ink-black serif headings, one bottle-green for action, hairline rules instead of boxes.
directions.composition: single reading column (max 68ch) with a left-aligned hero; sections divided by hairline rules; numbers set in tabular figures

directions.name: Signal poster
directions.idea: One oversized typographic statement on a saturated field; everything else small, precise and quiet.
directions.composition: asymmetric 12-column grid; the headline breaks the grid at display size; supporting copy in a narrow right column

directions.name: Control room
directions.idea: Dense, scannable, honest: the page reads like a well-made dashboard, with figures first and prose second.
directions.composition: two- and three-column grids above the fold; key facts as a definition list; one compact table; CTA pinned in the header

directions.name: Quiet gallery
directions.idea: Generous whitespace, one idea per screen, small type with real hierarchy; restraint as the signal of confidence.

type.display: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
type.body: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

directions.composition: centered narrow column; sections as full-height bands; no cards; images (if any) bleed to the edge

directions.name: Workshop grid
directions.idea: The engineer's notebook: visible grid, monospaced labels for data only, bright safety-yellow used once.
directions.composition: strict 4-column grid with visible column rules at section level; numbered steps in mono; one yellow-on-black call to action

directions.name: Sequence-led
directions.idea: Hierarchy carried by order: sections arrive in sequence as you scroll, each with one sentence and one figure; fully readable without motion.

motion.enter: opacity + translateY(16px) 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), triggered by IntersectionObserver, visible by default without JS
motion.reduced: everything visible at rest, no transforms

directions.composition: full-width bands, one claim per band, large figures; sticky progress rail on desktop only

directions.name: Civic plain
directions.idea: Government-service clarity: plain language, big tap targets, obvious links, nothing decorative; trust through legibility.
directions.composition: one column, headings as signposts, 44px minimum targets, the call to action is a plain green button

directions.name: Editorial split
directions.idea: Magazine spread: a large serif standfirst opposite a tight sans column, pull-figures in the margin.
directions.composition: asymmetric two-column spread (5/7); margin notes carry the figures; heavy rule under the masthead
